abort.source_added: The additional data source was added to the existing device.
abort.already_configured: This data source is already configured for the device.

user.title: Connect uradmonitor
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should connect to this UradMonitor device. Local access reads data directly from the device. Cloud access uses the UradMonitor REST API.

local.title: Connect local uradmonitor
local.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the UradMonitor device. The integration reads JSON data from the device's local API endpoint. If this device is already configured through cloud access, local data will be added to the same Home Assistant device. No API key is required.

data_description.port: The local API normally uses port 80. Change this only if your device uses another port.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the local device. Check the host and port.
error.invalid_response: The local device did not return a valid device ID.
error.unsupported_device: This device type is not supported yet. Please submit an issue with the complete /j response and the HTML returned by /. Redact public IP addresses or other sensitive information if needed.

cloud.title: Connect uradmonitor cloud
cloud.description: Enter the User ID and User key shown in the UradMonitor Dashboard. The integration will retrieve the devices available to your account.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the UradMonitor cloud API. Check the User ID and User key.

cloud_device.title: Select UradMonitor device
cloud_device.description: Select the device you want to add to Home Assistant. If it is already configured locally, cloud data will be added to the same Home Assistant device. Repeat setup to add another device.

init.title: Polling settings
init.description: Choose how often Home Assistant polls this device. Cloud devices using the same account share this setting.
